Before you start, give us half a minute to show you the most important things Dabbar can do for you.
Log your expense the way that suits you
By voice, plain typing, or a photo of a receipt — Dabbar understands and categorizes it on its own. Even from another app, you can Share the audio, image, or message straight to Dabbar.
Track your assets moment by moment
Add your stocks, currencies, or any assets you have, and Dabbar tracks their market prices as they change without opening 10 apps.
Dabbar reads your bank messages, with no password
No card linking and no personal password — just a simple permission for Dabbar to read bank or wallet messages, and your expenses log themselves. The whole thing takes under a minute.
Your income, budget, and commitments in one place
Write down your monthly income, set your budget, and record your fixed commitments like rent and installments — and Dabbar builds you the full picture of your money.
